categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/net_processing.cpp and src/private_broadcast.{cpp,h} with the P2P label to change outbound private broadcast connection behavior.
categories.rationale: Prevents adversaries from correlating broadcasts by returning transactions early to suppress remaining outbound connections. The PR description notes this 'addresses the theoretical timing attack' in private broadcast where transactions were prematurely removed upon receipt.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The changes to test/ and src/test/ are domain-specific functional and unit tests for private broadcast, and test_runner.py is only touched to register the new test.
categories.rationale: Does not touch testing infrastructure or harnesses; test additions merely accompany the P2P feature change.
